description: Zendesk requires a verified user to authenticate API requests using OAuth access tokens, basic authentication, or API tokens.

evidence.claim: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests and requires a verified user
Zendesk allows authentication via basic authentication, API token, or OAuth access token
Developers can obtain their own OAuth tokens or API tokens, indicating self‑serve credential access
Supported authentication methods are OAuth access token, basic authentication, and API token
